sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: If you are a manager or an administrator, Ganesha forecasts an outstanding day for you. Thing will turn out far better than your expectations. Even if you are in some other profession you will stand out at your workplace and be appreciated and admired. The latter half of the day will see you going out on spree with your spouse, or sweetheart. You will be brimming with energy and high spirits throughout the day.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: It isn't a good idea to try to fit people into a mold today, Taurus. This will only annoy others and frustrate you. It's important that you relax and simply let people blossom into the people they want to be. If you have a preconceived notion of who they should be, you're only setting yourself up for failure and disappointment, as well as anger from the other party.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Give your mind what it needs to think clearly and be prepared to act quickly, as the Libra Moon aligns with Neptune, Pluto, and Uranus. These electrifying vibes trigger exciting twists that can lead to major opportunities, dearest Taurus, even if you don't feel ready to take them on. Trust that your natural intellect and resourcefulness are enough for now. Though you prefer to be in control, the universe may be thwarting your plans in an attempt to guide you toward something bigger. Meditate on which areas of your life will require additional structure or discipline as you embark upon the next chapter once Luna opposes Saturn later tonight.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Evening with friends will be pleasant but take care as excessive eating could upset your next morning. Control your tendency to live for the day and to spend too much time and money on entertainment. Safeguard your interest when dealing with friends- business associates and relatives- as they might not be considerate to your needs. Today your artistic and creative ability will attract lot of appreciation and bring you unexpected rewards. Natives of this zodiac sign should read some spiritual books in their free time today. By doing this, many of your troubles can be overcome. Your spouse will do something really special for you today.

readings.text: You need to be ultra cool today. With numerous issues surrounding your work, your mind may not rest for a while before noon. However, as the day proceeds, you will relax a bit as problems sort themselves out. Keep your cool even if your superiors try to dominate you, suggests Ganesha.

Delegate duties instead of taking on everything yourself. You are in a key position. You have a good vantage point of everything around you. Give people tasks that will help the goal come to fruition. Make sure everyone is on the same page.

Safeguard your interest when dealing with friends- business associates and relatives- as they might not be considerate to your needs.

readings.text: The chances of easy recovery of pending payments are slim, even if you follow-up earnestly. As the day progresses, luck will support you a bit and you may have some fiscal gains.

This week, you have positive and negative news about your financial life. If you've been true to your goals and kept within budget, this planet provides new opportunities to make more money. If you've overspent, sudden and perhaps unexpected changes in your career sector could mean that what you counted on to cover bills may not be there. Saving for the future can get you through this time.

readings.text: While the day is going to begin with less enthusiasm, your creativity may get a boost in the second half of the day and you will be able to plan your time in a much better manner, says Ganesha. This will make you feel good.

If you don't already keep a dream journal, it's time to start. What we see in our dreams is often a direct message from the subconscious about new roads we need to take. It's not uncommon to see foods and forms of exercise (and other health practices) in your dreams. Paying attention to these unconscious messages is part of taking care of yourself. With time and dedicated attention, we become more skilled at recognizing the signs. Why be cut off from such a valid source of self-knowledge?

lucky.remedy: Health will be maintained by tying black and white thread on both the toes of your feet.

extras.text: This is no time for hesitation. All elements have fallen into place for success.
